steps.content: You are still fighting, struggling against the odds.
But the weapon you're wielding is no longer the shackles.
In your hands, you now grip that pair of crimson blades.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: The battlefield knows no mercy. Anyone could be the one to kill you. If you don't kill them, they'll kill you. If they don't kill you, they can't survive.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Shut up...
The voice from the deadly blades in your hands coils around you.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Glory, shame, hatred, profit, lies, justice... anything can lead to war, yet everything loses its meaning on the battlefield. The only truth in war is slaughter, and only victory can honor the sacrifices made.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Begging for peace in hell gets you nothing but trampled. The only way to earn it is to embrace the battlefield.
No... that's not right... You struggle against it, but the weapon in your grip refuses to stop.

It pulls you into a vast, unthinking army, where you no longer have to face yourself. Here, every soldier hears the same voice, marches in lockstep, their spectral figures moving as one. They rally beneath a single banner, and you see it all with terrible clarity.
Even in its distorted form, you recognize it... that's the flag of DisCity.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Kill... kill... kill... for yourself, for those you love, even for peace. Kill them. Let their skulls become vessels of your triumph, offerings to the heavens—this is the only purpose the enemy serves...

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: The enemy... is war's one undeniable truth...

steps.speaker: ?? & ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Shut up!
Slap! Someone covers your ears.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Shh... it's alright now. Don't listen to that voice, it's dangerous.
Your body moves forward, driven by the blades in your hands as they slash toward the woman's throat, but you're too slow. "Jasmine" catches your wrists effortlessly.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Oh, come now. It's obvious you don't really want to hurt anyone. Don't let it take over. Just relax your grip, slowly... I know you are strong enough to fight it. You've totally got this.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: There you go... just loosen your grip. Let me help you toss it away.
She takes the blades from your hands and hurls them far away.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: All done! Now, let's get you back where you belong.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: This place is just dreadful for you, isn't it? But don't worry, you can trust me. Those things cannot control me. After all... I am the master of this world.
She speaks with pride, indifferent to the churning sludge gnawing madly at her bare feet—or perhaps... she simply doesn't care.
"Jasmine" links her arm through yours as you both navigate through a battlefield shrouded in gunsmoke.

No... this isn't her. No matter how similar they look, the girl in front of you is human—her gaze meets yours as an equal. But the Jasmine outside... However she disguises herself, she always looks at you like a beast eyeing a human.
...The person before you is whole, complete. She... is not the Jasmine you know.

Before you can ask anything more, gunfire erupts all around. Bullets rain down at your feet, sending your nerves into overdrive and twisting your gut into knots. Yet, despite the chaos, she gives your hand a reassuring pat.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Don't be afraid. Turn your mind away from the guns and bullets. Just imagine me dancing, and listen again... Don't they sound like drums now? Da-da-da-da-da... A perfect little rhythm for my dance.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Every year we celebrate the harvest season. I'm the best dancer around, the star of the celebration! Everyone comes to my performance, cheering for me. The details? I'll tell you little by little. Just picture it in your head, and you won't be afraid anymore.
And so she speaks to you softly, as if flames were never meant to burn houses and fields—only to light bonfires and candles, to roast sizzling delicacies, to kindle the glow of a heartful feast.

She says bullets and arrows need not take lives. Instead, the targets woven with flowers by young maidens stand tall in the distance, waiting to be struck. Pierce the red bullseye at the heart, and one might just win true love.

She says parade floats loom as massive as tanks in her homeland, bearing scarecrows through the fields. Villagers line the paths in joyous celebration, praying for gentle rains, for heavy sheaves of grain, for health and prosperity.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Look! Fireworks!

You glance up to see a massive artillery shell hurtle toward you. With a mere point of her finger, it explodes midair, blooming into dazzling fireworks that erupt across the sky. Darkness shatters into radiant light, the weight of fear dispelled, terrified screams now joyous cheers.

At this moment, your mind clears, and you see a lightless river stretching beneath your feet. It forms a boundary, a divide. Beyond it lies a vast and silent shore, untouched by the chaos and confusion of this side. That is where you belong.
"Jasmine" watches you, her gaze gradually softening.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Looks like everything's fine now. You should head back. And next time... maybe don't wander in here so carelessly, okay?
...Indeed, you already know enough. This place is far too dangerous for you to stay. It's time to leave and never return. The real fight is waiting for you on the other side.
"Jasmine" takes your hand and leads you forward, guiding you to step into the river. But something makes you hesitate. Your grip tightens instinctively, holding her back as you turn to face her—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come with me, to the outside world. Real celebrations are waiting out there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The war is over now. You don't need to stay here anymore.
She does not resist. Taking her silence as consent, you draw her softly to your side.

But with one mere step forward, the river surges over her feet, and the hand you're holding begins to dissolve. Cracks race along the scars mapping her body, and she crumbles right before you, her smile flaking away like old paint piece by piece. The harder you hold on, the faster she slips through your fingers like grains of sand... until you have no choice but to let go.
She looks at her crumbling hand, then turns to you, still with a smile.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: See? Don't even bother.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I can't leave, not for a long time now.

The river surges between you, its swift currents carving an impassable divide. Through the rippling water, she waves goodbye, watching as you leave. Only when the distance swallows you whole does she turn away, stepping back into the world she belongs to, the one on the other side.
[Small CG: Village with Softer Filter]
Across the river, you see the village engulfed in flames. Amidst the hellish inferno, the long-dead stir, twisting, rising one by one. And then, they begin to sing.

steps.speaker: Village Chief
steps.content: We've hit the jackpot, you little wretches! We're set for years. No more worries, not even about war! Every deal's locked in. Now party like there's no tomorrow!

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Well, well! If we're not wasting gunpowder hunting or picking fights, we can blow it all on the biggest fireworks show ever, right?
The remains of a soldier are pulled upright. He fumbles for his gun, only to have it snatched away.

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Hey, even if you're a guest from DisCity, no causing trouble! No fighting, no hurting people! Come on, drop the gun. Let's watch Jasmine dance!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Haha, come on! Wherever I am, there's always a celebration!

A gigantic bonfire surges skyward. Around it, fragmented phantoms gather, their faces smeared into oblivion, indistinguishable as friend or foe. Gunfire cracks, drums pound—they dance, spectral and frenzied, a celebration of the already-dead. Hell and revelry shatter, then fuse, twisting into a single, unending moment. This is her eternity.
And "Jasmine" stands atop a high stage at the heart of the battlefield, her blood-stained blades flashing as she dances, each movement a celebration of harvest and peace.
Only upon waking do you grasp the truth: when war broke out, her hometown was in the middle of such a celebration, and then everything was frozen forever on that day.
[Scene Transition] You're awake, Jasmine is not

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Only 3 minutes and 21 seconds left. Fortunately, you made it back in time. Chief, the experiment was a success with both your body and mind intact. We've collected critical data to optimize the LINK project, which should enhance your future understanding of Sinners.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Though you don't look all that pleased.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: She hasn't woken up yet, but it should be soon.
Jasmine has been moved to a ward bed for health monitoring. She's moaning softly, as if trapped in a nightmare—probably the one you know.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: <size=25>Mmm...</size>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The experimental data confirms that Sinner Jasmine's mental state is in significantly worse condition compared to DisCity Sinners. This is directly tied to the Outlands' strategic stance toward DisCity. Had they engaged more actively with DisCity in recent years and systematically studied our anti-Mania technology, her condition might not have declined to this degree.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Jasmine has lost all conscious will. She's highly sensitive to Mania and extremely susceptible to influence. Fraser likely assumed she could be easily "used" for their purposes, but after a thorough investigation, I believe this is as far as she can go.

You gently take Jasmine's hand. Despite the experiment's original intent, you've uncovered nothing about Fraser, the mission she was given, or the conspiracy behind it—no traces, no leads. Maybe deep in her subconscious, those people truly mean nothing to her. Or perhaps she's simply trapped in that moment.

But for you, it's different. The image of her hand dissolving still lingers in your mind. And the fractured battlefield from your dream haunts you just as vividly. Fraser's conspiracy is no longer the only mystery driving you forward. Now, there are even more questions demanding answers.

options: I may know why Fraser sent her here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In her memories, I saw an army, one flying DisCity's flag. Their weapons were unlike anything I'd ever seen... Not like the anti-Mania devices FAC uses now. No, these were something else entirely—brutal, powerful, built purely for killing. Worse yet, they could even drive people into a bloodthirsty frenzy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So that's how Jasmine got corrupted, right? She took those blades from that DisCity army and brought them back here. Maybe Fraser sent her just to rub that history in our faces... Heh, that's vile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Judging by her age in the dream, that war wasn't that long ago, but I've rarely heard anyone mention it.
You look at Schorl.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hardly anyone in DisCity ever talks about that DisCity army. And what's the deal with those "weapons"? Tell me about that war.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or is this something I'm not supposed to know?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Approval complete. EDGE has granted you exclusive access to this information. However, it may not be appropriate for me to be the one to explain. Please wait a moment, Chief.
After a series of electronic beeps, there's a knock at the door. Your adjutant appears in the doorway with a grave expression.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Chief.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Nightingale?
